evidence.why: Client-side field holding a vendor (OpenAI) API key that is used directly by the mobile app.
The vendor credential is attached directly to requests sent from the client to api.openai.com, meaning the key must be shipped inside the mobile app to function.
Client calls the third-party vendor API directly rather than routing through the developer's own authenticated backend, requiring the OpenAI key to live in the shipped client.

controls_present: HTTPS used for the OpenAI endpoint
